# Paddle Board Overstock

> Paddle Board Overstock designs and manufactures professional-grade inflatable watercraft — SUP boards, kayaks, dinghies, RIBs, safety equipment, and accessories — in its own 12,000 m2 factory in Weihai, China.

Founded in 2012 in Weihai, China, Paddle Board Overstock operates 6 production lines with 200-300 staff and an annual capacity of 15,000 units. Every unit passes a 24-48h hold at 1.25x rated pressure under an ISO 9001:2015 (SGS) quality system; products carry CE, UKCA, REACH, RoHS certification, the factory is BSCI compliant, and outgoing shipments achieve a 99.3% defect-free rate (AQL 2.5 per ISO 2859 sampling). Paddle Board Overstock exports to 50+ countries. MOQ: 1 unit — overstock clearance, no MOQ for SUP/kayak, 1 unit — overstock clearance, no MOQ for RIB; sampling lead time 3-7 days, production 5-15 days. Since September 2026 the brand has been operated by Weihai Dongjilian Co., Ltd. (New Mexico, USA), with R&D and production at the Paddle Board Overstock Qingdao Manufacturing Hub.

- [Quality Control](https://paddleboardoverstock.com/quality/): ISO 9001:2015 quality system, 24-48h hold at 1.25x rated pressure, AQL 2.5 per ISO 2859 sampling
